<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation (break a C–Cl bond, form a new C–C bond). We can search the template catalog for templates that break a C–Cl bond (bond type 6‑1) and form a C–C bond (bond type 6‑6). This should return candidate template IDs we can then apply to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1",
    "bonds_broken": ["6-1"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
